name: Sarkoth's Mangled Claw
summary: Across the southern bluffs of the Valley of Trials, Sarkoth's Mangled Claw bears the mark of a wounded hunter. Hana'zua crushed the scorpid's pincer before its venomous sting struck him down.

sections.title: A Trophy of Vengeance
sections.body:
Hana'zua, a young Darkspear troll, met Sarkoth while hunting in the Valley of Trials. The massive scorpid pierced his chest with its venomous stinger, leaving him bleeding beneath a nearby tree.

Before the sting, Hana'zua crushed the beast's pincer. The battered claw proves Sarkoth has been slain. For the wounded hunter, its scar shows that his desperate strike found its mark and preserves his warrior's honor as venom courses through his veins.

faq.answer: Sarkoth's pincer was crushed in a desperate duel with Hana'zua, a troll hunter. Sarkoth stung Hana'zua in the chest, but the troll struck before the beast's claw could close around his leg.

Hana'zua asks for the claw. Badly wounded beneath a tree in the Valley of Trials, he fears he will die there. He wants Sarkoth slain to uphold his honor; seeing the deed done steels him to endure until Gornek sends aid.

faq.q: Where did this claw come from?
faq.answer: The claw came from Sarkoth, a large, aggressive scorpid prowling the elevated plateau along the southern cliffs of the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

angles.text: As a troll, bringing the claw to Hana'zua gives a dying Darkspear kinsman some dignity. He learns his final strike scarred the beast before the end.
As a member of the Horde, claiming the trophy in the Valley of Trials marks an early test of courage and martial strength in Durotar's harsh wilds.
